purpose: First bounded pretrained-27B native-memory accuracy pilot
evaluation: All 110 held-out examples, all six arms, full answers, greedy, max 64 new tokens
checkpoint_selection: Predeclared final step only; no held-out checkpoint selection
notes: This is the minimum 100-memory Stage A pilot, not the 1000-memory primary milestone.
The earlier eight-case GGUF control is not the text baseline for this pilot.
No image exporter, live Aimee memory, or serving deployment.
No automatic expansion or retry based on held-out scores.
